_phase_5_16_rationale: This codebase uses a mix of `.js` and no-extension imports deliberately: ESM (run via tsx/esbuild) requires the *emitted* extension on relative imports, so any `import './foo.js'` works in both the TS source and the JS runtime. The trade-off is that the TypeScript checker doesn't see the extension (only the runtime does) and `allowImportingTsExtensions: true` lets us use `.ts` for type-only files like `globals.ts` and `types/express.ts`. We accept the mixed style for the operational simplicity of a single import path that works in both worlds. A future migration to pure ESM with explicit extensions (or pure ESM with bundler-only paths) is tracked separately.
